definitions.explanation: A very deep, dark shade of blue, darker than ordinary navy. Commonly used for suits, school uniforms, and formal clothing.

examples.japanese: {濃紺|のうこん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦スーツ→スーツ：01367_suutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}ている→着る：00541_kiru⟧。
examples.english: He is wearing a dark navy suit.

examples.japanese: ⟦{制服|せいふく}→制服：03086_seifuku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{濃紺|のうこん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ブレザー→ブレザー：28533_burezaa⟧だ。
examples.english: The school uniform is a dark navy blazer.

examples.japanese: {濃紺|のうこん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{黒|くろ}→黒：02205_kuro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{近|ちか}い→近い：00530_chikai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{光|ひかり}→光：01707_hikari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{当|あ}たる→当たる：01860_ataru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{青|あお}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分|わ}かる→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。

notes:
